arguments.sql:
SELECT s.StatusType, s.FundingType, COUNT(*) AS schools,
       COUNT(f.CDSCode) AS frpm_matches, COUNT(t.cds) AS sat_matches,
       COUNT(t.AvgScrRead + t.AvgScrMath + t.AvgScrWrite) AS combined_scores,
       SUM(typeof(t.AvgScrRead) = 'text' OR typeof(t.AvgScrMath) = 'text' OR typeof(t.AvgScrWrite) = 'text') AS text_scores,
       MIN(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") AS min_frpm,
       MAX(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") AS max_frpm
FROM main.schools AS s
LEFT JOIN main.frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
LEFT JOIN main.satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.Charter = 1
GROUP BY s.StatusType, s.FundingType

SELECT
    s.FundingType AS funding_category,
    COUNT(*) AS active_charter_schools,
    SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS total_k12_enrollment,
    ROUND(100.0 * AVG(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)"), 2) AS avg_frpm_eligible_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(t.AvgScrRead + t.AvgScrMath + t.AvgScrWrite), 2) AS avg_combined_sat
FROM main.schools AS s
LEFT JOIN main.frpm AS f
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
LEFT JOIN main.satscores AS t
    ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND s.Charter = 1
    AND s.FundingType IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
GROUP BY s.FundingType
ORDER BY s.FundingType
LIMIT 2
